raw_Final.answer: The net change in the balance of unrecognized tax benefits from the end of fiscal 2007 (December 29, 2007) to the end of fiscal 2008 (December 27, 2008) was an increase of $87.8 million. This equals the December 27, 2008 ending balance of $214.4 million minus the beginning-of-2008/end-of-2007 balance of $126.6 million.
